reference.valuesNote: Values below come from browser CSS, without copied color or size values. Refresh after editing CSS.
reference.colorsNote: Edit color values in src/app/globals.css. Use classes by purpose and pair surface colors with text colors.

reference.fontNote: Listing a font does not load it. The font used for each glyph depends on the device and fallback; this does not prove Noto Sans Thai is used on every device.
reference.typographyNote: Samples show existing utilities and their baseline usage. The team must still review typography roles for the new theme.
reference.metrics: Values in order: font size / font weight / line-height (sizes and line heights are measured in px)

reference.variantsNote: Import specific files. Use the variants and sizes that Button supports. Replace example copy with feature translations.
reference.statesNote: Button supports disabled. The loading demo uses disabled + aria-busy + an icon, with no loading prop. Form demos validate locally and send no data.
reference.rulesNote: Use semantic colors and shared components. Keep page layouts in features. Check callers before changing props, and preserve labels, focus and keyboard behavior.
